name: Gym Locker Availability Report
query:
SELECT
  `tabGym Locker`.name as "Locker:Link/Gym Locker:120",
  `tabGym Locker`.locker as "Locker Name:Data:150",
  `tabGym Locker`.status as "Status:Select/Available,Unavailable:120",
  `tabGym Locker`.locker_fee as "Locker Fee:Currency:110",
  `tabGym Locker`.duration as "Duration (days):Int:120"
FROM `tabGym Locker`
ORDER BY `tabGym Locker`.status ASC, `tabGym Locker`.locker ASC
